en: The postcard's front features a black-and-white winter landscape with snow-covered ground, leafless trees, and a small town nestled at the base of forested hills. The town appears to have several prominent, recognizable old buildings. The text 'Sundsvall' is printed in red ink at the bottom right, with additional handwritten text in Swedish across the lower part of the card. The reverse side is labeled 'BREFKORT' and includes Swedish, French, and universal postal terms, with a green Swedish stamp (5 öre, featuring a profile of a man) and a postmark reading 'KRISTIANSTAD'. The postcard is addressed in Swedish to 'Herr Sven Slog, Karlsberg, Tristad.'
